description: Policy-guarded agent payment vault on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). initialize_vault, update_policy, initialize_fee_vault, deposit_fees, ensure_vault_token_account and execute_pay_exact were verified: an allow-listed merchant received 985_000 of 1_000_000 lab tokens and the LobsterPay treasury received the 1.5% service fee.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of sepivip/lobsterpay. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/lobsterpay. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (initialize_vault, update_policy, fee vault, execute_pay_exact)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/lobsterpay/
QA: devnet proof of an allow-listed agent payment with a service fee
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise execute_swap_exact_in against a devnet swap program
